vedic_reference.note: सगण (सगण्) is a Sanskrit word which means 'Victory in War'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word सग (सग्) which means 'together' or 'with'. The long meaning of the name is विजयी सेना (vijayī senā), which means 'victorious army'.

data.cultural_impact: 'Sagan' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sahasrānāmam', a revered hymn consisting of a thousand names of Lord Vishnu, emphasizing the Hindu belief in the immensity and complexity of the divine deity, and the interconnectedness of all existence. In popular Hindu culture, 'Sagan' is also invoked as the god of the sky or space, representing the boundless expanse and wonder of the universe.
data.spiritual_significance: As the guardian of the universe, 'Sagan' is revered as a symbol of protection, security, and sustenance in Hindu mythology. His spiritual significance extends to the cosmic realm, encompassing the creation, preservation, and destruction of all existence, reflecting the Hindu concept of cyclical time and the continuous transformation of the universe. Through prayer and invocation, devotees of 'Sagan' seek his divine sponsorship for prosperity, wisdom, and spiritual growth.

historical_references.reference: The Sagan clan, also known as Sagana or Sahukar, were a prominent merchant family from the medieval Indian city of Gujarat. They are believed to have originated from Sindh and gained significant wealth through trade with the Middle East and Africa.

Sagan Saiyid, also known as Sadullah Khan, was a military commander and nobleman who served under the Mughal Emperor Aurangzeb during the late 17th century. He is known for leading the successful siege of the fort of Mandu in 1691 and later becoming the governor of Malwa.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Sagan' is most commonly associated with the renowned astronomer, Carl Sagan. His influence on popular culture can be seen across multiple platforms. His television series, 'Carl Sagan's Cosmos,' made science accessible and captivating for millions around the world. Sagan's name continues to trend on Twitter, as users discuss various scientific topics, often referencing his groundbreaking work. Additionally, Google searches for 'Carl Sagan' spike when significant astronomical discoveries or anniversaries occur.

data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Sagan in Hinduism symbolizes the purifying power of fire. It is believed that the soul is purified and illuminated through the divine flame of consciousness. The name is a reminder to keep the inner flame of awareness burning brightly.
